g.title: cluster_crop
g.text: 2b-4 For every cut-out (≤ 60), both ways up at once

g.title: in
g.text: Shelf photos of one scan (up to 8 places)

g.title: blur
g.text: skip blurry photos if a sharp one exists

g.title: det
g.text: Qwen3-VL: boxes as JSON (photo at 1280 px, ≤ 1500 tokens)

g.title: rot
g.text: Turn the photo for each lean group (≤ 3)
and find spines again with Qwen3-VL

g.title: sur
g.text: Surya OCR reads the lines ×2 ways

g.title: cut
g.text: Final straight cut at the spine's own angle

g.title: find
g.text: 2b-7 For books only the whole read saw:
Qwen3-VL locates the spine by title,
cut + check as above (Surya must confirm the title)

g.title: merge
g.text: most frequent spelling wins, best cut-out kept
